summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of BOOSTER MAG social growth service app. All backend APIs (20/20 tests) and frontend flows (8/8 tests) passed successfully. Payment is simulated, order progress is time-based as expected.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/packages (Instagram/TikTok, Followers/Likes/Views) - all variants working
Backend: POST /api/orders - order creation with correct pricing calculation (base * quality + upgrades)
Backend: GET /api/orders/lookup - by email and order_number both working
Backend: POST /api/boost - normal username returns success, username with 'private' returns private:true
Backend: GET /api/stats - returns order counts and stats
Backend: POST /api/admin/login - correct password returns token, wrong password returns 401
Backend: GET /api/admin/orders - requires Bearer token, returns orders with summary, status filter working
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id} - status update sets progress to 100% when completed
Frontend: Home page loads with hero, benefit marquee, how it works, testimonials carousel, FAQ accordion, CTA
Frontend: Multi-step checkout - quality tier tabs (Active/Premium/VIP), delivery speed selection, package grid with best seller badges
Frontend: Purchase Step 0 - username input, package selection, continue button all working
Frontend: Purchase Step 1 - upgrades toggles (instant, bonus_likes, etc.), order summary with correct total
Frontend: Purchase Step 2 - payment form (email, card, expiry, cvv, name), order creation, confirmation with order number
Frontend: Dashboard - lookup tabs (email/order number), order card with progress bar, delivered count, auto-refresh
Frontend: Boost flow - normal username shows success with follower count animation, private username shows private state with retry button
Frontend: Admin panel - password login, orders table, status filter dropdown, logout button
Frontend: Contact page - form submission (name, email, message), success message display
